title: Chemistry of C-Trimethylsilyl-Substituted Heterocarboranes. 19. Synthetic and Structural Studies on Trinuclear Ln(III) Carborane Clusters [Ln(III) = Sm, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho]. I. Conversion to Sandwiched Manganese(II) and Cobalt(III) Carborane Complexes

material_class.structural_family: trinuclear lanthanacarborane cluster (tricapped trigonal prism of nine metal atoms)

synthesis.procedure: Under dry nitrogen in a Pyrex high-vacuum flask, closo-exo-4,5-Li(THF)2-1-Li(THF)2-2,3-(SiMe3)2-2,3-C2B4H4 was prepared from nido-2,3-(SiMe3)2-2,3-C2B4H6 and t-BuLi in THF. THF was removed in vacuo, the solid was redissolved in dry benzene (30 mL), and the solution was reacted with anhydrous SmCl3 (2:1 carborane:LnCl3) for 5 h at 0 °C then 24 h at room temperature with stirring. The turbid light-yellow mixture was filtered; the residue was washed with benzene and discarded. Solvent removal from the filtrate and washings gave an air-sensitive solid that was recrystallized from benzene.
synthesis.temperature: 0 °C for 5 h, then room temperature for 24 h
synthesis.time: 5 h at 0 °C then 24 h at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Pyrex round-bottom flask (250 or 100 mL) with magnetic stirring bar and high-vacuum Teflon valve; drybox/glovebag under dry nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter through a frit, wash residue with anhydrous benzene, remove solvent in vacuo, recrystallize from benzene (pale yellow crystals by slow evaporation).
synthesis.yield: 1.17 g, 0.54 mmol, 59% (based on SmCl3 as limiting reagent)

properties.summary: Described as a sandwiched paramagnetic samaracarborane cluster; no quantitative magnetic susceptibility or optical/luminescence measurements are reported (NMR of 1 is qualitative identification only).
